verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a portfolio view or a native dashboard that rolls up progress across multiple projects or boards. The closest items do not qualify: 'dashboard widgets' (monday-docs-3) are developer building blocks for custom apps, and the 'one dashboard' (monday-docs-10) covers admin oversight of agent access and AI credit spend. Generic claims about spotting progress gaps or a 'cross-platform view' via integrations do not describe aggregating project progress.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view
